descriptions._close_r: newlib _close_r: clears errno, calls the close syscall stub and copies a nonzero errno into the reentrancy structure on failure.
descriptions._fstat_r: newlib _fstat_r: clears errno, calls the fstat syscall stub and copies a nonzero errno into the reentrancy structure on failure.
descriptions._lseek_r: newlib _lseek_r: clears errno, calls the lseek syscall stub and copies a nonzero errno into the reentrancy structure on failure.
descriptions._read_r: newlib _read_r: clears errno, calls the read syscall stub and copies a nonzero errno into the reentrancy structure on failure.
descriptions._write_r: newlib _write_r: clears errno, calls the write syscall stub and copies a nonzero errno into the reentrancy structure on failure.
descriptions.__sread: newlib __sread: reads from the stream's file with _read_r and advances the cached offset, or clears the offset-valid flag on error.
descriptions.__swrite: newlib __swrite: seeks to the end for append streams, clears the offset-valid flag and writes with _write_r.
descriptions.__sseek: newlib __sseek: seeks with _lseek_r and caches the new offset, or clears the offset-valid flag on error.
descriptions.__sclose: newlib __sclose: closes the stream's file with _close_r.
descriptions._fwalk: newlib _fwalk: calls a function on every open stream of every glue block of the reentrancy structure and ORs the results.
descriptions.w3d_newlib_std_802eb178: SN version of newlib std (findfp.c): initializes a FILE with flags, file number, default read/write/seek/close hooks and reentrancy pointer; leaves _bf._size.
